Also used Hong Kong Mark Six lottery info, World Cup football, basketball matches to run gambling, sit as bookmaker, collect bets, with Wu 1 (吴1) as accomplice. Total gambling amounts: 5,364,200 + 4,139,334 = 9,503,534? Actually second part says 4,139,334? Let's sum: they list various amounts: 1,562,088 + 7,000 + 787,690 + 40,000 + 263,182 + 1,800 + 7,264 + 13,800 = 2,783,? Let's compute: 1,562,088+7,000=1,569,088; +787,690=2,356,778; +40,000=2,396,778; +263,182=2,659,960; +1,800=2,661,760; +7,264=2,669,024; +13,800=2,682,824. Then plus Wu1's involvement: 1,113,736. So total for that part: 2,682,824+1,113,736=3,796,560. Then second part: football: 149,000+150,050+212,000+243,737+654,970 = 1,409,757. Third part: basketball: 46,753. So total gambling amount: 5,364,200 + 3,796,560 + 1,409,757 + 46,753 = 10,617,270. So large.
